values.en: Invariance under Reparametrization with the Same Normal
values.zh-CN: 同法向重参数化下的不变性

values.en: Let $\Omega\subseteq\mathbb R^2$ be Euclidean open and $X:\mathbb R^2\to\mathbb R^3$ be smooth and regular on $\Omega$. At $q\in\Omega$, put $U=X_u(q)$ and $V=X_v(q)$; these form a basis of $T_qX$. Choose a smooth unit normal field $\boldsymbol N:\mathbb R^2\to\mathbb R^3$ on $\Omega$ as in the normal context. Let $\widetilde\Omega\subseteq\mathbb R^2$ be open and $\phi:\widetilde\Omega\to\Omega$ be a smooth diffeomorphism onto an open subset (the transformation formulas themselves require only $C^2$). Set $Y=X\circ\phi$ and $\widetilde{\boldsymbol N}=\boldsymbol N\circ\phi$ on $\widetilde\Omega$ (arbitrary total extensions outside suffice). For $r\in\widetilde\Omega$, $q=\phi(r)$, identify $T_rY=T_qX$ as ambient vector subspaces. For every $w,z$ in this plane, $\mathrm I_Y(r;w,z)=\mathrm I_X(q;w,z)$ and $\mathrm{II}_{Y,\widetilde{\boldsymbol N}}(r;w,z)=\mathrm{II}_{X,\boldsymbol N}(q;w,z)$. If $J=D\phi_r$, the coefficient matrices obey $A_Y=J^TA_XJ$ and $B_{Y,\widetilde{\boldsymbol N}}=J^TB_{X,\boldsymbol N}J$. By contrast, if each chart independently uses its ordered-cross-product normal, then $\boldsymbol N_Y(r)=\operatorname{sgn}(\det J)\boldsymbol N_X(q)$. A negative determinant negates the second form relative to the transported normal, but never the first. The sign is locally constant and constant on each connected component.
values.zh-CN: 设 $\Omega\subseteq\mathbb R^2$ 为欧氏开集，$X:\mathbb R^2\to\mathbb R^3$ 在 $\Omega$ 上光滑且正则。取 $q\in\Omega$，记 $U=X_u(q)$、$V=X_v(q)$，它们构成 $T_qX$ 的一组基。选定法向语境中的光滑单位法向场 $\boldsymbol N:\mathbb R^2\to\mathbb R^3$（条件只在 $\Omega$ 上要求）。设 $\widetilde\Omega\subseteq\mathbb R^2$ 开，$\phi:\widetilde\Omega\to\Omega$ 是到某开子集的光滑微分同胚（变换公式本身只需 $C^2$）。在 $\widetilde\Omega$ 上令 $Y=X\circ\phi$、$\widetilde{\boldsymbol N}=\boldsymbol N\circ\phi$（域外任意作全空间延拓）。对 $r\in\widetilde\Omega$、$q=\phi(r)$，把 $T_rY=T_qX$ 识别为同一环境向量子空间。对其中任意 $w,z$，$\mathrm I_Y(r;w,z)=\mathrm I_X(q;w,z)$ 且 $\mathrm{II}_{Y,\widetilde{\boldsymbol N}}(r;w,z)=\mathrm{II}_{X,\boldsymbol N}(q;w,z)$。令 $J=D\phi_r$，系数矩阵满足 $A_Y=J^TA_XJ$、$B_{Y,\widetilde{\boldsymbol N}}=J^TB_{X,\boldsymbol N}J$。若两个参数化各自独立选用有序叉积法向，则 $\boldsymbol N_Y(r)=\operatorname{sgn}(\det J)\boldsymbol N_X(q)$。负行列式使第二形式相对输运法向变号，但第一形式不变。符号局部常值，在各连通分支上为常数。
